Description

I tried to open my friends profile to invite them to somewhere, but the UI was refusing to load the profile at all. It was not like this a few days ago, and has been happening every single time since sunday. Another issue that happens very often, but not all the time, is the social tab failing to load all my friends properly, so sometimes it loads some of them and then loops over and over, and sometimes it won't load at all.

Reproduction Steps

Seems to work if I keep going in and out of the UI for that persons profile. but not if I wait like normal.

Details

- Category: User Interface

- Frequency: Always
